name: Silver Etchant
description: Silver Etchant is a mixed acid formulation of phosphoric acid, nitric acid, and acetic acid optimized for selective wet etching of silver thin films and silver-containing alloys in semiconductor manufacturing. The nitric acid oxidizes the silver surface, phosphoric acid complexes the dissolved silver ions, and acetic acid controls the etch rate for uniform material removal. This etchant is used in advanced interconnect and packaging processes where silver metallization requires precise patterning. The formulation provides controlled, isotropic etching with clean surface finish and minimal attack on adjacent dielectric materials.
physicalProperties: Appearance: clear colorless liquid; Density: ~1.3 g/cm³; pH: <1; Boiling Point: varies by formulation
